caption:
Mongolia ate 141 kg of meat per person in 1961. Sixty years later it still leads, at 136 kg.

Watch the United States climb to the top in the nineties, watch a dzud wipe out Mongolia's herds in 2001, and watch Mongolia take the lead back in 2021.

📊 See meat available per person, country by country, from 1961 to 2023 in this animated ranking, in kilograms a year. Explore how the world doubled its meat supply per head, and which countries eat several times the global average.

Source: FAO (2025), processed by Our World in Data (CC BY 4.0). This is supply at the end of the chain, not measured intake. FAO regional aggregates, dependent territories and states under one million people are excluded; the footer line is the world average, not a total.
